title: Optimize Console — Recommendation Cards, Diff Sandbox, and Recoverable Apply Timeline
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Problem: Teams are hesitant to apply automated batching/caching recommendations because the Console currently only shows a high-level savings number and lacks a stable, reviewable change record. Operators want a safe, reversible way to preview what a configuration apply will do and to audit who did what later.

Goal: Design and ship a coherent Console surface that combines recommendation cards, an interactive diff sandbox (rehearsal mode), and a recoverable apply timeline so that customers can safely adopt batching and KV-caching suggestions with clear visibility into cost/latency trade-offs and an immutable audit trail. This ticket scopes the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and follow-up work for the first implementation delivered in console-2025.04.

Scope:
- Recommendation cards for Optimize with actionable controls (preview, open diff sandbox, schedule apply).
- Diff Sandbox that can simulate a configuration change against a representative workload to surface token-level cost delta, 95p latency delta, and expected throughput impact.
- Recoverable Apply Timeline: safe-apply workflow that creates an immutable apply entry (with snapshot of previous config), supports canary window, automatic rollback triggers, and manual rollback.
- Audit trail entries with links to the commands/PRs and metrics snapshot at apply time.

Out of scope (for this ticket): server-side policy engine for automatic rollback based on SLO anomalies (tracked in ENG-19845).
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards display: estimated monthly token savings, estimated percentile latency change (p50/p95), confidence score (low/med/high), and primary risk tags (e.g., cold-cache, long-seq).
Diff Sandbox shows before/after config diff, simulated token-level cost delta, simulated latency histogram (p50/p95), and a short replay log of exemplar requests used for simulation.
Operator can run a sandbox simulation without affecting live serving or caches and can save a sandbox run as a named preview snapshot.

Apply action performs a transactional config change that creates an immutable timeline entry: who applied, snapshot of prior config, sandbox snapshot reference, metrics baseline snapshot, and optional canary settings.

Automatic rollback can be triggered manually or by a simple SLO monitor (threshold-based) configured during apply; rollback restores prior config snapshot and records a rollback entry in the timeline.
All timeline entries are queryable by date, user, recommendation id, and include links to associated GitHub PR or Confluence design doc where applicable.

Telemetry: within 30 days post-release, at least 20% of Optimize recommendations that are applied originate from the sandbox preview flow and mean time to rollback is reduced by 40% for applied batching changes.
Design: Figma frames for card, diff modal, and timeline got final sign-off from Design and Security.
